Nora (People Ops): Quick internal announcement: two updates going live 2026-04-15 — Emergency Caregiver Leave (ECL) and Volunteer Time Off (VTO). ECL: up to 5 paid days in a rolling 12-month period for urgent caregiver needs (child/elder/medical emergency/foster placement). VTO: 16 paid hours per year for company-approved volunteer activities. Full policy: https://intranet.redwood.example/hr/policies/ecl-vto
Nora (People Ops): Operational highlights: ECL taken in half-day increments, separate from PTO accruals, manager approval in HiBob within 48 hours (retrospective allowed for true emergencies). VTO needs prior manager sign-off; no cash-out.
Alex (Finance): We'll add payroll code "ECL_PAY" to track hours and update expense tags for emergency travel reimbursements (cap increased to $2,000 per incident). Corporate card acceptable when available.
Chen (Legal): Treat ECL as taxable wages; we'll add regional notes on tax/treaty implications to the doc. Also added a short reminder about confidentiality when handling medical-related leave.
Sam (Engineer): Quick Q — my kid was sent home from school today. Can I use ECL same day?
Nora (People Ops): Yes, same-day caregiver events qualify. If you expect extended time off, coordinate with your manager for PTO or unpaid leave for longer coverage.
